Federal Reserve keeps interest rates steady as economic uncertainty rises
NBC News
11900000 subscribers
57 likes
5828 views
19 Mar 2025
The Federal Reserve is holding interest rates steady as it weighs the impact of Trump’s tariffs and federal workforce cuts on inflation and the economy. The central bank warned that economic uncertainty has grown and now expects core inflation to run higher than previously projected.
